name: Casablanca no Tsubomi
source:
Thump, thump, thump...
A burning desire surged through every inch of my body, crimson hot.
Thump, thump, thump...
A dark, filthy passion bursts forth.
A pure white flower, untouched by impurities.
You, so pure and delicate, forbidden to be touched.
I want to taint you, I want to possess you, I want to love you.
With my color, as mine, with my love.

The protagonist, Itsuki Naruse, was still unaware.
It lurked within his peaceful and calm everyday life...
His true nature.

His daily life spent with Shiina Yuri as his girlfriend.
But behind the scenes, due to a certain incident, he becomes involved with Miku Hirayama and Kana Shijou.
A forbidden, destructive, and abnormal relationship.

The bud of Casablanca is yet to bloom.
[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=947113]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
扑通、扑通、扑通……
一股强烈的欲望涌遍全身每一寸，赤红火热。
扑通、扑通、扑通……
一股阴暗肮脏的激情爆发了。
洁白的花朵，没有一丝杂质。
你，那么纯洁，那么细腻，不许被触碰。
我想玷污你，我想占有你，我想爱你。
用我的颜色、我的、我的爱。

主角成濑树还没有意识到。
它潜伏在他平静而平静的日常生活中……
他的真实本性。

他的日常生活是和椎名由里作为女朋友一起度过的。
但在幕后，他因某件事而与平山未来和四条加奈产生了联系。
一种被禁止的、破坏性的、不正常的关系。

卡萨布兰卡的花蕾尚未绽放。
